svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 20 — "The Tall Ones" — Section 5 opens
svg.desc: Page 20: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full widescreen / half-half / full). Section 5 opens. Theodore + Luma walk home through fog. Wide street establishing — gas lamp halos, damp cobbles, Luma's lenses scanning from his pocket. Theodore slows beneath a gas lamp, fidgets with his brass gear ring, asks if he may tell her something. Close-up into pocket — Luma listens. Final wide: Theodore tells the Tall Ones stories his grandmother told. Luma's scanner has reactivated, brightening from the pocket. Two mythologies, two visitors, two sets of stories.
